en.html:
...Not a pleasant awakening.
A dull ache <ruby>lingered<rt>lingered</rt></ruby> deep inside my skull.

Apparently I had dreamed something unpleasant. No memory remained. If it had been a nightmare, perhaps not remembering was a blessing.

Chachamaru Ashikaga was already gone. Muramasa stood beside me in spider form.

I was about to speak to her when the door opened.

ja.html:
……快適な目覚めではなかった。
　頭蓋の奥に鈍い頭痛が<ruby>蟠<rt>わだかま</rt></ruby>っている。

　どうも良くない夢を見たらしい。
　記憶は何も残っていないが、悪夢であるなら、覚え
ていなくて幸いというものだろう。

　足利茶々丸は、既にいない。
　村正は蜘蛛の姿で傍らにいる。

　声を掛けようとした時、戸口が開いた。

en.html:
ｅｔｃ／堀越女中"Good morning."
Kageaki"...Good morning."
ｅｔｃ／堀越女中"Your meal is ready. Would you like it now?"
Kageaki"...Yes, thank you."
ｅｔｃ／堀越女中"Certainly. Please wait a moment."
Kageaki"Where is Her Excellency the lieutenant general?"
ｅｔｃ／堀越女中"She finished her meal a little while ago and is in her office. If you need her, I can announce you..."
Kageaki"No... That will not be necessary."
